title: Sparkly rose
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='roseGlow' cx='50%' cy='45%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff4466'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#cc1144'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='petalGrad' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff7799'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ee2255'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Stem -->
  <path d='M50 62 Q48 76 46 90' stroke='#33cc55' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 62 Q52 76 55 90' stroke='#22aa44' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- Leaves -->
  <path d='M48 72 Q36 68 32 76 Q38 80 48 76 Z' fill='#33cc55'/>
  <path d='M48 72 Q38 70 34 74' stroke='#55ee77' stroke-width='1' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M52 80 Q64 76 68 84 Q62 88 52 84 Z' fill='#2ab84a'/>
  <path d='M52 80 Q62 78 66 82' stroke='#55ee77' stroke-width='1' fill='none'/>

  <!-- Rose petals - outer ring -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='44' rx='14' ry='12' fill='#dd2255' transform='rotate(-20 36 44)'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='44' rx='14' ry='12' fill='#dd2255' transform='rotate(20 64 44)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='32' rx='12' ry='10' fill='#ee3366'/>
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='52' rx='12' ry='9' fill='#cc1a4a' transform='rotate(-10 40 52)'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='52' rx='12' ry='9' fill='#cc1a4a' transform='rotate(10 60 52)'/>

  <!-- Rose petals - middle ring -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='38' rx='10' ry='8' fill='#ff5577' transform='rotate(-15 44 38)'/>
  <ellipse cx='56' cy='38' rx='10' ry='8' fill='#ff5577' transform='rotate(15 56 38)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='48' rx='10' ry='7' fill='#ee3366'/>

  <!-- Rose petals - inner spiral -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='42' rx='7' ry='6' fill='#ff7799' transform='rotate(-25 48 42)'/>
  <ellipse cx='53' cy='42' rx='7' ry='6' fill='#ff7799' transform='rotate(25 53 42)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='45' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#ff99bb'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='43' rx='3' ry='2.5' fill='#ffbbcc'/>

  <!-- Rose highlights -->
  <path d='M44 36 Q46 34 48 35' stroke='#ffaacc' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M56 36 Q58 34 60 35' stroke='#ffaacc' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- Sparkles -->
  <g fill='#ffee66'>
    <!-- top left sparkle -->
    <path d='M22 18 L23.5 22 L27 23.5 L23.5 25 L22 29 L20.5 25 L17 23.5 L20.5 22 Z'/>
    <!-- top right sparkle -->
    <path d='M78 15 L79.2 18.2 L82.5 19.5 L79.2 20.8 L78 24 L76.8 20.8 L73.5 19.5 L76.8 18.2 Z'/>
    <!-- left sparkle -->
    <path d='M12 48 L13 50.5 L15.5 51.5 L13 52.5 L12 55 L11 52.5 L8.5 51.5 L11 50.5 Z'/>
    <!-- right sparkle -->
    <path d='M88 42 L89 44.5 L91.5 45.5 L89 46.5 L88 49 L87 46.5 L84.5 45.5 L87 44.5 Z'/>
    <!-- bottom left small -->
    <path d='M28 62 L28.8 64.2 L31 65 L28.8 65.8 L28 68 L27.2 65.8 L25 65 L27.2 64.2 Z'/>
    <!-- bottom right small -->
    <path d='M72 68 L72.8 70.2 L75 71 L72.8 71.8 L72 74 L71.2 71.8 L69 71 L71.2 70.2 Z'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Tiny sparkle dots -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='28' r='1.2' fill='#ffe855'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='30' r='1.2' fill='#ffe855'/>
  <circle cx='20' cy='58' r='1' fill='#ffe855'/>
  <circle cx='82' cy='56' r='1' fill='#ffe855'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='18' r='1.3' fill='#fff0aa'/>
</svg>
